name: Agent Governance Policy
description: Machine-readable governance policy defining agent behavioral boundaries, acceptable use, and operational constraints. Every deployed agent must operate under a declared policy that specifies what it can do, what data it handles, and under what conditions it operates.
threat_addressed: Agents operating without governance policy lack defined behavioral boundaries, creating uncontrolled risk exposure. Without documented policies, organizations cannot demonstrate due diligence, meet regulatory requirements, or maintain consistent agent behavior across deployments.
enforcement_mechanism: Validates that a governance policy (ancilis.yaml) is loaded, syntactically valid, and covers required governance fields including agent identity, scope constraints, data handling declarations, and operational mode. Policy version and review dates are tracked.

security_outcome.pass: Governance policy loaded, validated, and covers all required agent behavioral boundaries.
security_outcome.fail: Governance policy missing, invalid, or incomplete.

display_detail: Validates that a machine-readable governance policy exists, is current, and defines agent behavioral boundaries.
remediation_hint_template: No valid governance policy found. Create an ancilis.yaml with agent identity, scope constraints, and data handling declarations.
